  | description              = This blade of light cries out to destroy Strahd.
  | tips                     = 
* This is an in-quest item given by [[Rudolph van Richten]] to one of the player characters at the start of the raid.
* Striking Strahd with this weapon is required to make him vulnerable to damage for a short period of time. (This is not the same as the debuff [[Vulnerable]] - if Strahd goes a few seconds without being attacked with the Sunsword, he becomes completely immune to all damage.)
** Do ''not'' allow the player holding the Sunsword to be killed during the staircase section - if the Sunsword falls into a location it cannot be retrieved from, the remainder of the raid becomes incompletable.
* The [[Durability]] is 390 maximum but it comes with 100 damage, so it is effectively 290.
